newsitem.title: FINLAND: K-S PUHELIN SEES A SHARE ON BROKER'S LIST APRIL 28.
newsitem.headline: K-S PUHELIN SEES A SHARE ON BROKER'S LIST APRIL 28.

text.p: Finnish regional telecoms operator Keski-Suomen Puhelin Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it had submitted an application to have its A shares quoted on the Broker's list, and that it expected trade to start April 28.
Following a share issue that ended in mid-March, Keski-Suomen Puhelin Oy had 205,977 A shares and 58,642 K shares, the company said.
At the end of 1996, Keski-Suomen Puhelin had 48,235 registered shareholders, it said.
The biggest are the state of Finland, with 1.6 percent of the shares, and the city of Jyvaskyla, with 1.1 percent, it said.
In 1996 Keski-Suomen Puhelin had an operating profit of 15.5 million markka on net sales of 146.1 million markka, it said.
